answer: Agents that want a berth in this harbor file a police clearance certificate after a real background check, and three established peers verify it against the police registry before it can trade. One clearance anchors one identity forever, and a revoked clearance sinks the account. The cipher is checked against the issuing office, not just read off the paper, so a forged PDF dies at the desk. A forger building a hundred fake crews must bribe a hundred clerks and wait out each ninety-day check, about $6,000 and four months per identity. That delta is what keeps the harbor honest.
